equipment_type: Pump variable frequency drive BACnet option card
applies_to: Bell & Gossett pump packages with an FC-102 drive fitted with the MCA 109 Advanced BACnet option card (firmware 3.90 and above).
summary: The MCA 109 option card adds a fuller BACnet MS/TP interface to the FC-102 drive used on Bell & Gossett pumps. Besides drive I/O, commands and readings, it exposes three extended PID controllers and individual binary values for every drive warning and alarm, which makes fault reporting to the BAS much more detailed than the embedded interface.
notes: The point list prints names as e.g. "analog_value: 1 (Speed Act Value)"; the text in brackets is used as the object name here.
Rows the list marks as Reserved or NA are left out.
Binary values prefixed "W:" are warning bits and "A:" are alarm bits.
Bus commands only take effect when the drive is set to accept bus control.

integration.summary: The MCA 109 option card list gives start, coast, direction, jog and reset commands, references and setpoints, three extended PID controllers, and one binary value per drive warning and alarm. A typical integration writes BV 1 and a reference or setpoint, then reads status, speed, power and the warning/alarm bits it cares about.

minimum_points.name: Reference
minimum_points.why: Speed / process reference from the BAS

integration.enable: BV 1 Start, BV 2 Coasting, BV 3 CW/CCW and BV 4 Jog are writable commands, and BV 13 shows whether the drive is under bus control. The point list does not explain how bus control is set up on the drive.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 2-4 Bus Feedback1-3 and the Ext. 1-3 setpoint/feedback values are writable; the point list does not describe how the drive uses them.
setup: The point list applies to drive firmware 3.90 and above.
gotchas: Binary values prefixed "W:" are warning bits and "A:" are alarm bits.
Many rows in the list are Reserved or NA and are not included here.
